say:1:1441117001:1.text: The missiles barely leave a scratch on it...
say:1:1441117001:1.source_cn: 炮火进了它的眼连一粒灰尘都不如……

say:3:1441117003:1.text: Only Helthor knows how much time I've spent on my research!
say:3:1441117003:1.source_cn: 天知道我在研究所里研究、改造、迭代了多少次！

say:4:1441117004:1.text: The power-charging method, energy conversion efficiency, and the precision of penetration... Oh, when will I finally succeed?
say:4:1441117004:1.source_cn: 聚能的方式，转换的效率，贯穿的精度……赫托啊！

choice_prompt:5:1441117004.text: The power-charging method, energy conversion efficiency, and the precision of penetration... Oh, when will I finally succeed?
choice_prompt:5:1441117004.source_cn: 聚能的方式，转换的效率，贯穿的精度……赫托啊！

say:6:1441117005:1.text: We dwarves in exile once returned to Brimstone Village, our homeland.
say:6:1441117005:1.source_cn: 很久以前，四处流亡的矮人们回到了故土深岩村。

say:7:1441117006:1.text: To witness the unparalleled craftsmanship of the Ironheart Dominion and the gods, the first thing we did was explore the underground ruins.
say:7:1441117006:1.source_cn: 为了亲眼见证钢心帝国和神明的伟大工艺，第一件事就是勘探...

say:8:1441117007:1.text: I was the youngest member of the pioneer team, always the first to charge into caves and mines that others were too afraid to enter.
say:8:1441117007:1.source_cn: 我是勘探队年纪最小的先锋，别人不敢钻的坑洞、不敢探的矿...

say:9:1441117008:1.text: It was during that expedition that I mistakenly drank dragon egg essence, and I haven't aged since.
say:9:1441117008:1.source_cn: 也是在那个时候，我误饮了龙蛋液，一直保持这副模样到现在。

choice_prompt:10:1441117008.text: It was during that expedition that I mistakenly drank dragon egg essence, and I haven't aged since.
choice_prompt:10:1441117008.source_cn: 也是在那个时候，我误饮了龙蛋液，一直保持这副模样到现在。

say:11:1441117009:1.text: It's a deviously clever curse from the dragon to grant me eternal youth.
say:11:1441117009:1.source_cn: “永葆青春”，多狡猾的龙，多别出心裁的诅咒。

say:12:1441117010:1.text: Now, my companions on that expedition have all grown old.
say:12:1441117010:1.source_cn: 当年那些和我一起追寻失落的钢心帝国技艺的伙计们老了。

say:13:1441117011:1.text: Most have given up on reviving the crafts of the Ironheart Dominion, while others have taken paths I cannot approve of.
say:13:1441117011:1.source_cn: 大部分人都放弃了重现钢心帝国的技艺，少数人走上了我不认...

say:14:1441117012:1.text: I'm the only one who still remembers the dragon's curse, as my face constantly reminds me.
say:14:1441117012:1.source_cn: 只有我记得，我的模样时刻提醒着我，龙的诅咒从来没有消失。

say:15:1441117013:1.text: The dragon loathes us. As long as it exists, the curse in our blood will persist.
say:15:1441117013:1.source_cn: 它憎恨着矮人，只要它存在一日，矮人血脉的诅咒就会延续下去。

say:16:1441117014:1.text: We'll forget the skills our ancestors once had and the glory of our old kingdom...
say:16:1441117014:1.source_cn: 矮人会忘记古老的帝国技艺，忘记曾经帝国的光辉，忘记那个...

say:17:1441117015:1.text: So, I moved to the lab, hoping to develop artillery strong enough to take down a dragon!
say:17:1441117015:1.source_cn: 于是我独自搬到了研究所，开始研究威力足够屠龙的火炮武器。

choice:5:1:2.text: Do you want to slay the dragon?
choice:5:1:2.male: Do you want to slay the dragon?
choice:5:1:2.female: Do you want to slay the dragon?
